name: medondo holding AG
summary: medondo holding AG, together with its subsidiaries, provides software solutions in Germany. The company offers Online Diary, an online appointment calendar; digital anamnesis & clarification, which records patient's relevant health information before the appointment; practice marketing & visibility that publishes regular specialist articles in practice blog, as well as publish specialist articles on channels for an online presence; Form Designer that create customized forms; and Patient Portal, which make documents and forms available digitally and enable patients to make appointments and follow-up appointments. It also provides self-check-in; digital patient file, which provides information about patients; practice TV & patient management that integrates the patient call function directly into the practice TV; co-treatment portal, which shares findings, X-ray images or treatment reports; and digital documents & signature that provides patients with important documents digitally via the patient portal or by e-mail and have documents signed electronically. In addition, the company offers digital invoices; follow-up appointment management & appointment reminders; digital medical history & explanation; digital patient record; digital factoring; quality management & documentation; and appointment quotas & controlling software. Further, it provides product-related services, such as training, consulting, maintenance, and support services. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Munich, Germany.
